cases.title: Tommy gun · five bursts
cases.description: Five complete bursts from the original Tommy-gun file. Hear the recording, a designed low body, and both together. The source keeps its room and cadence; the synthesized body is an interpretation.

credits.title: Source: USC Cinema / Sunset Editorial Collection

takes.title: Tommy recording
takes.description: The complete original Tommy-gun sequence: five bursts and the room between them.

takes.title: Tommy body
takes.description: Five fading noise beds add low pulsing weight at the recorded burst groups.

takes.title: Tommy hybrid
takes.description: The complete Tommy-gun recording meets its designed body, with the original shot rhythm preserved.

cases.title: M16 rifle · sustained burst
cases.description: One sustained M16 rifle burst, followed by its natural room tail. The recording is not repeated. Compare it with the pulsing body and hybrid at the same measured listening level.

credits.title: Source: USC Cinema / Sunset Editorial Collection

takes.title: M16 recording
takes.description: One sustained automatic-rifle burst and its full natural room tail, from the original M16 file.

takes.title: M16 body
takes.description: A fading low noise bed pulses beneath the sustained burst; it does not recreate individual shots.

takes.title: M16 hybrid
takes.description: The original M16 burst and room tail combine with a low synthesized body.
